lines.title: Vestil Electric Hydraulic Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Vestil's core electric hydraulic scissor lift tables, rated 1,000 to 12,000 lb, with narrow and economy versions.
lines.content:
EHLT tables are Vestil's standard powered scissor lifts for assembly, pallet handling, order picking and work positioning. Standard safety features include an electric toe guard, internal velocity fuses, an upper travel limit switch and maintenance props, with a push-button hand control.

Capacities run from 1,000 to 12,000 lb with 33 to 60 in. of travel, and quick-ship and partially stainless steel models are offered. The range also includes the EHLT-N, with a narrow 16 x 48 in. platform for tight work cells, and the economical EHLT-E, a 2,000 lb table with an internal power unit.
key_features: Electric toe guard and internal velocity fuses
Quick-ship and partially stainless steel models
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables

lines.title: Vestil Powered Lift Tables with Manual Rotation
lines.excerpt: Electric lift turntables with a round top that rotates 360 degrees by hand, rated 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
HST tables combine powered lift with a round platform that rotates a full 360 degrees by hand, so operators can turn the load instead of walking around it during wrapping, packing, assembly and inspection.

Lifting and lowering is by a standard foot control for hands-free height adjustment. Models are rated at 4,000 lb and run on 110V single-phase power.

lines.title: Vestil Single Scissor Lift and Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Uni-Tilt hydraulic lift and tilt tables that tilt 40 degrees, rated 2,000 to 6,000 lb, including a portable version.
lines.content:
UNI Single Scissor Lift & Tilt Tables raise and tilt containers, bins and totes to bring parts closer to the operator. Lift and tilt can be controlled independently, and a high retaining lip on the tilt side keeps material in place.

Models tilt 40 degrees and are rated from 2,000 to 6,000 lb, in a wide range of platform sizes, colors and voltages. The portable UNI-P version has fork pockets so a forklift can move it between work stations.
key_features: High retaining lip on the tilt side
Portable UNI-P version with fork pockets

lines.title: Vestil Ground Lift Scissor Tables
lines.excerpt: Ultra-low-profile scissor tables that load at ground level with a pallet truck, rated 2,000 to 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
Ground Lift Scissor Tables lower to about 1/2 in., so pallets and containers can be rolled on with a pallet truck and raised to working height without a pit or ramp. An entry-side electric toe guard and a safety velocity fuse are standard, and the remote power unit can sit up to 8 ft away.

Models are rated from 2,000 to 4,000 lb. A version with handrails is built for loading and unloading semi trucks with a pallet truck where no dock or forklift is available.
key_features: Lowers to about 1/2 in. for pallet truck loading
Remote power unit up to 8 ft away
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Vestil Pneumatic and Air Bag Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Air-powered scissor lift tables with no hydraulic oil or electrical components, from 200 lb up to 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
Vestil's pneumatic tables raise the platform on factory air, with no electrical power or hydraulic oil. The light-duty AT tables have a chrome-plated deck and foot-operated air valve for clean work areas, laboratories and assembly stations.

ABLT Air Bag Scissor Lift Tables use an air bag with a pressure relief valve and a captured scissor track, and raise pallets and bins at 80 to 100 psi and 15 cfm. Heavy-duty ABLT models add an adjustable upper travel limit valve, pinch point guards and foot controls.
key_features: Factory air power; no oil or electrics
AT light-duty and ABLT air bag models

lines.title: Vestil Low Profile Electric Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Low-collapsed-height electric lift tables for pallet jack loading without a pit, rated 2,000 to 3,000 lb.
lines.content:
Vestil's low profile electric lift tables have very low collapsed heights so pallets can be loaded with a pallet jack without a pit. EHU tables have an open-center U platform and EHE tables a solid platform with center support, both with an external power unit and push-button controls.

EHLTX tables load skids with a pallet truck using an optional approach ramp, with an electric perimeter pinch point guard and a remote 460V three-phase power unit under a protective cover. Capacities across the range run from 2,000 to 3,000 lb.
key_features: Low collapsed heights for pallet jack loading
Remote power unit with protective cover
Electric toe guards and velocity fuses
categories: Lift Tables > Low Profile Lift Tables

lines.title: Vestil Electric Lift and Tilt Scissor Tables
lines.excerpt: Electric hydraulic lift and tilt tables in 45 and 90 degree versions, rated 1,000 to 5,000 lb.
lines.content:
EHLTT tables combine vertical lift and controlled tilt to set materials at safer working angles for loading, unloading, assembly and pallet handling. Restraining chains and raised retaining lips secure the load.

Models tilt 45 or 90 degrees and are rated from 1,000 to 5,000 lb. Safety features include perimeter toe guards, velocity fuses, upper travel limit switches, maintenance props and weather-resistant hand controls.
key_features: Perimeter toe guards and velocity fuses

lines.title: Vestil Electric Double Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: High-lift electric double scissor tables with 60 or 72 in. of travel, rated 1,000 to 5,000 lb.
lines.content:
EHLTD tables use a double scissor mechanism for extended vertical reach, raising materials to elevated work heights while staying stable. Displacement-style cylinders and high-pressure components are built for heavy daily use.

Models are rated from 1,000 to 5,000 lb with 60 or 72 in. of travel, raising to 70 or 84 in. Electric toe guards meet OSHA pinch point requirements, and internal velocity fuses are standard.
key_features: Electric toe guards and velocity fuses
categories: Lift Tables > Double Scissor Lift Tables

lines.title: Vestil Portable Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Battery-powered mobile scissor lift tables for transporting and raising loads, rated 1,000 to 5,000 lb.
lines.content:
PST tables both carry and raise heavy loads, and in many cases replace a forklift for material handling, assembly and order picking. A heavy-duty 12V DC power unit with deep-cycle batteries and onboard charging drives push-button lifting.

Models are rated from 1,000 to 5,000 lb with 35 to 48 in. of travel. Standard features include electric pinch point guards, floor locks and key-operated power, on glass-filled nylon or phenolic casters.
key_features: 12V DC battery power with onboard charging
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Vestil Work Station Electric Hydraulic Scissor Tables
lines.excerpt: Compact work station scissor tables rated 1,500 lb, with external or internal power units.
lines.content:
Work station scissor tables raise products to an ergonomic height using little floor space. An electric toe guard is standard, and the open design works from all four sides.

Models are rated at 1,500 lb with a 13 second travel time on three-phase power. EHLT-WS tables have a 460V external power unit that can sit 8 ft away, in steel or partially stainless steel. EHLT-WSI tables have an internal power unit.

lines.title: Vestil Zero Lift and Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Floor-level lift and tilt tables loaded with a hand pallet truck, tilting 45 degrees at 2,000 or 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
Zero Lift & Tilt Tables load at floor level with a standard hand pallet truck, with no pit, then lift the load to working height and tilt it up to 45 degrees. Lift and tilt are controlled separately.

Models are rated at 2,000 or 4,000 lb, with platforms from 44 x 51-1/2 in. to 52 x 71-1/2 in. and raised level heights of 36 or 48 in.
key_features: Loads with a hand pallet truck
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Vestil Rotary Air/Hydraulic Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Air-over-oil scissor lift tables powered entirely by factory air, rated 3,000 lb.
lines.content:
AHLT tables lift hydraulically using a rotary air/oil power unit driven by factory air, for areas where electrical components are impractical or restricted. They need at least 80 cfm at 80 psi.

Pneumatic upper travel limit switches, toe guards and internal velocity fuses are built in, sleeve bearings are lubricated for life, and a two-button hand control sits on an extended hose. Listed models are rated at 3,000 lb.
key_features: Air-over-oil hydraulic lift on factory air

lines.title: Vestil Table Top Scissor Lift Table
lines.excerpt: A compact electric linear actuated scissor lift for workbenches, rated 200 lb.
lines.content:
The EMLT is a small electric scissor lift that sits on an existing workbench, table or assembly station to bring small, heavy objects to a comfortable height. A linear actuator raises it quickly and limits drift compared with hydraulics.

It is rated for 200 lb, lowers to 5 in. and raises to 20 in., with an open-sided design and hand control on 115V power.
key_features: Lowers to 5 in., raises to 20 in.

lines.title: Vestil Portable Electric Hydraulic Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Electric hydraulic lift tables on casters with a removable handle, rated 1,000 to 3,000 lb, including a version with a jib hoist.
lines.content:
EHLTP tables put the strength of an electric hydraulic scissor lift on smooth-rolling casters with a removable handle, for facilities that need lift table performance without a fixed installation. A corded hand pendant raises and lowers the load from a safe distance.

Models are rated at 1,000, 2,000 and 3,000 lb, in a range of platform sizes and AC or DC power options. One version adds a winch-operated jib crane and adjustable outriggers to lift and swing oversize parts onto the deck.

lines.title: Vestil Hinge and Sliding Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Electric hydraulic tilt tables that tilt 45 degrees at 4,000 lb, in hinge and sliding-link designs.
lines.content:
EHTT tables tilt containers, bins and parts to a better working angle. Each is rated at 4,000 lb and tilts up to 45 degrees, with an internal power unit, double-acting cylinder and push-button control on an 8 ft coil cord.

The hinge model is a rugged stationary tilter with four lag-down points. The sliding model uses a patented sliding link that keeps it stable in minimal floor space, moving the container's front edge away from the operator as it tilts.
key_features: Internal power unit and double-acting cylinder

lines.title: Vestil Ground Tilter
lines.excerpt: A floor-level tilter loaded with a pallet truck that tilts containers 45 degrees, rated 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
The GLT-4000 Ground Tilter is for tilting jobs where containers are loaded with a pallet truck. It rotates containers up to 45 degrees from floor level.

The platform has a 17-1/2 in. lip on the tilt side and a removable positioning bar for smaller containers, with pinch point guards on the loading side. A 2 HP 460V three-phase remote power unit and hand pendant are standard.
key_features: Loads at floor level with a pallet truck
Remote power unit with hand pendant
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Vestil Electric Hydraulic Tandem Lifting Tables
lines.excerpt: Tandem scissor lift tables for long loads, rated 2,000 to 4,000 lb on platforms up to 144 in. long.
lines.content:
EHLT-TL tables use dual scissor lifts under one long platform for lifting and positioning large, heavy items. The open design loads and unloads from all sides.

Models are rated from 2,000 to 4,000 lb, with platforms up to 144 in. long, a hand control and 460V three-phase AC power.
key_features: Open design loads from all sides

lines.title: Vestil Lift and Tilt Workstation Tables
lines.excerpt: Workstation tables that lift and tilt together up to 44 degrees, rated 2,000 to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
ULTT tables lift and tilt at the same time for simple operation, with a maximum tilt of 44 degrees and a service range of 10 to 24 in. A full-width lip at the platform end supports containers.

Models are rated from 2,000 to 6,000 lb, with an internal power unit, two-button hand pendant and optional foot control.

lines.title: Vestil Shorty Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Small-deck electric scissor lift tables for tight spaces, in single and double leg styles.
lines.content:
Shorty Scissor Tables raise products to an ergonomic height where space is tight, with smaller decks sized to the available room. They come in single leg (EHLTS) and double leg (EHLTSD) styles.

Models are rated from 500 to 4,000 lb with 24 in. of travel. A full-perimeter pinch point guard, internal velocity fuse, 460V three-phase external power unit and hand control are standard.

lines.title: Vestil Ground Lift and Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Floor-level lift and tilt tables loaded with a hand pallet truck, tilting 45 degrees at 2,000 to 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
Ground Lift & Tilt Tables load with a standard hand pallet truck and need no pit, then lift or tilt products to an ergonomic working position. Lift and tilt are controlled separately.

Models are rated from 2,000 to 4,000 lb and tilt 45 degrees, with a remote power unit and hand-held control.
key_features: Loads with a hand pallet truck
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Vestil Tilt Master Container Tilters
lines.excerpt: Portable fork tilters that lift, move and tilt containers 90 degrees, in AC, DC, manual and stainless versions.
lines.content:
Tilt Masters lift, transport and tilt containers, bins and palletized loads up to 90 degrees, as an alternative to forklifts and lift tables. Standard and straddle (TMS) models handle a wide range of pallets and skids, with capacities up to 6,000 lb and a push-button pendant control.

The line also includes the 2,200 lb battery-powered TM-22-DC and manual TM-22-M for open-bottom crates, boxes and pallets, both available in stainless steel, and the ULMA stainless steel Tilt Master for washdown areas.
key_features: Lift, transport and tilt to 90 degrees
Standard and straddle models up to 6,000 lb

lines.title: Vestil Economy Transporter/Tilter
lines.excerpt: A foot pump cart that moves loads between stations and tilts them 23 degrees, rated 2,500 lb.
lines.content:
The Economy Transporter/Tilter moves products between work stations and tilts them for easy access. A hydraulic foot pump tilts the deck 23 degrees in 11 strokes.

It is rated for 2,500 lb and rolls on two swivel casters with brakes and two rigid glass-filled nylon casters, with a removable handle.

lines.title: Vestil Bench Top Tilters
lines.excerpt: Tilters that mount on workbenches and lift tables, tilting loads 0 to 45 degrees.
lines.content:
Bench Top Tilters attach to industrial table tops, workbenches and mobile lift tables to set work at a better angle. Powered models tilt from 0 to 45 degrees from a 5 in. lowered height with a pendant control on an 8 ft cord.

Electro-mechanical models with an internal mechanism lift up to 500 lb, and external-mechanism models up to 1,000 lb. A manually adjustable tilter sets at 15, 30 or 45 degrees for occasional changes.
key_features: Mounts on benches and lift tables

lines.title: Vestil Efficiency Master Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Heavy-duty tilt tables with a 24 in. deck height, tilting 45 or 90 degrees at 2,000 to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
Efficiency Master tables tilt pallets, crates, boxes and baskets for loading and unloading, with a 24 in. deck height when level. EM1-200 models tilt 45 degrees, and EM1-500 models tilt a full 90 degrees with a double-acting cylinder for upending products.

They are all-welded, with a 2 HP 460V three-phase motor, a NEMA 4 push-button control and fork pockets on 30 in. centers. Models are rated from 2,000 to 6,000 lb.

lines.title: Vestil Corner Tilters
lines.excerpt: Corner tilters for gaylords and bulk containers, in air bag and electric hydraulic versions.
lines.content:
Corner Tilters tip bulk containers, gaylords and crates toward a corner so material collects where it can be reached. The Air Corner Tilter works on factory air: its air bag tilts the container automatically as it empties, up to 45 degrees, and is rated for 1,500 lb.

The EMC Electric/Hydraulic Corner Tilter tilts 29 to 30 degrees with a 2 HP 460V three-phase motor and push-button control, at 2,000 or 4,000 lb, with built-in fork tubes for moving it by forklift.
key_features: Air bag and electric hydraulic versions

lines.title: Vestil Spring Scissor Tables
lines.excerpt: Self-leveling spring pallet tables with a 360 degree rotating top, for loads up to 4,500 lb.
lines.content:
Spring Scissor Tables keep pallet loads at a comfortable working height as items are added or removed, using a spring scissor mechanism. A large circular top rotates 360 degrees by hand so operators can reach every side.

Models self-level loads from 400 to 4,500 lb, with fork pockets for moving by forklift.

lines.title: Vestil Self-Elevating Spring Tables
lines.excerpt: Spring-counterbalanced work tables that rise as weight is removed, rated 230 to 1,120 lb.
lines.content:
Self-Elevating Spring Tables use internal counterbalance springs to raise or lower the platform with the load, keeping parts, cartons and supplies at a steady working level. Springs can be added or removed to tune the table to the product.

Capacities run from 230 to 1,120 lb, with platforms from 20 x 20 in. to 30 x 30 in. and service ranges of 11 to 33 in. or 15 to 38 in.
key_features: Platforms from 20 x 20 in. to 30 x 30 in.

lines.title: Vestil Self-Elevating Lift Carts
lines.excerpt: Spring-loaded self-leveling carts that keep loads at working height, rated 400 to 2,000 lb.
lines.content:
Vestil's self-elevating carts, including Auto-Hite carts, lower as material is added and rise as it is removed, keeping the top of the load in an ergonomic range. Spring tension is adjustable for different loads.

Models are rated from 400 to 2,000 lb on polyurethane casters with a removable handle. On some models the handle and casters can be removed to make a stationary adjustable table.

lines.title: Vestil Hydraulic Post Tables
lines.excerpt: Portable post-style lift tables for dies, castings and parts, rated 200 to 6,000 lb, with rectangular and round tops.
lines.content:
Hydraulic Post Tables raise, lower and move dies, castings, molds and machine parts, with telescoping posts that stabilize the load. They roll on two rigid casters and two swivel casters with brakes.

The range includes single-speed and two-speed foot pump, auto-shift and 12V DC powered models, rated from 200 to 6,000 lb. Round-top models give access from all sides and come in steel or partially stainless steel.
key_features: Foot pump, auto-shift and DC powered models

lines.title: Vestil Air Hydraulic Post Tables
lines.excerpt: Post tables raised by air/oil power or foot pump, rated 1,000 to 2,000 lb.
lines.content:
Air Hydraulic Post Tables raise the platform with a reciprocating air/oil power unit and push-button control, and a single-speed foot pump fine-tunes the height. They need air at 72 to 100 psi through at least a 1/4 in. hose.

Models are rated from 1,000 to 2,000 lb, in powder-coated steel.
key_features: Air/oil power with foot pump backup

lines.title: Vestil Linear Actuated Post Table
lines.excerpt: A battery-powered linear actuated post table for precise positioning, rated 200 lb.
lines.content:
The linear actuated post table raises and lowers for exact positioning and stays level throughout its travel. A lithium battery with an onboard charger powers it, and it rolls on casters between sites.

It is rated for 200 lb, with a hand pendant on a 6 ft coil cord and a standard emergency stop.
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Vestil Mechanical Post Tables
lines.excerpt: Hand crank post tables that hold height without drift, rated 1,000 to 2,000 lb.
lines.content:
Mechanical Post Tables use a precision sprocket and gear mechanism for positive height adjustment with no downward drift. A two-speed crank moves heavy loads 1/8 in. per turn or lighter loads 5/16 in. per turn.

Low-profile and high-profile models are rated from 1,000 to 2,000 lb, with platforms from 18 x 28 in. to 30 x 60 in.

lines.title: Vestil Die Tables
lines.excerpt: Compact foot pump die tables for lifting heavy tooling, rated 1,100 to 2,000 lb.
lines.content:
Die Tables lift heavy equipment such as dies to working height with a foot-pump-operated hydraulic pump and lift cylinders. Their small frame reaches hard-to-access locations.

They are all-welded steel, rated from 1,100 to 2,000 lb, on two rigid and two swivel casters with side brakes. A chrome top is available on foot pump models.

lines.title: Vestil Hydraulic Elevating Carts
lines.excerpt: Foot pump scissor lift carts rated 220 to 4,000 lb, with stainless, scale and auto-shift versions.
lines.content:
Hydraulic Elevating Carts let operators load at one height, move the load and raise or lower it at the destination. Single and double scissor designs, in steel or aluminum, give a range of lift heights with capacities up to 4,000 lb.

The range includes partially stainless steel carts for labs, healthcare and food service, carts with a built-in scale accurate to 0.1 percent, and auto-shift carts whose two-speed foot pump changes speed with the load.
key_features: Stainless, built-in scale and auto-shift versions
categories: Lift Tables > Stainless Steel Lift Tables

lines.title: Vestil Mechanical Scissor Carts
lines.excerpt: Hand crank scissor lift carts with a screw drive that holds height, rated 330 to 1,000 lb.
lines.content:
Mechanical Scissor Carts are raised by a central hand crank and screw drive that holds the platform with no downward drift, and need no hydraulics, batteries or power.

Models are rated from 330 to 1,000 lb, with a smooth steel platform and polyurethane casters. Partially stainless steel versions are available.

lines.title: Vestil Premium Scissor Lift Carts
lines.excerpt: Heavy-duty foot pump scissor carts for order picking, die handling and assembly, rated 300 to 1,000 lb.
lines.content:
Premium Scissor Lift Carts are built of heavy-duty steel for lifting and transporting loads, order picking, die handling and assembly support. A single-speed foot pump raises the deck, with an overload protection valve in the hydraulic system.

Models are rated from 300 to 1,000 lb. Foot-operated carts have a tilt-up top for safe maintenance, and swivel casters have guards and brakes.

lines.title: Vestil Low Profile Scissor Lift Carts
lines.excerpt: Low-profile scissor carts that load near the floor, rated 200 to 2,000 lb, in foot pump, auto-shift and DC versions.
lines.content:
Low Profile Scissor Lift Carts make it easy to load products from the floor or low surfaces, then raise them to an ergonomic height. The standard carts use a two-speed foot pump with a speed control valve, and auto-shift models, with a 3-1/2 in. lowered height, change pump speed automatically with the load.

Heavy-duty low profile carts rated at 2,000 lb are offered with a foot pump or DC power. Across the range capacities run from 200 to 2,000 lb.
categories: Lift Tables > Low Profile Lift Tables

lines.title: Vestil Stainless Steel Scissor Carts
lines.excerpt: 304 and 316 stainless steel hydraulic scissor carts for washdown and sanitary areas, rated 200 to 1,100 lb.
lines.content:
Stainless Steel Scissor Carts are fully welded for food processing, pharmaceutical, medical, laboratory, cleanroom and wet environments, in 304 or 316 stainless steel.

Models are rated from 200 to 1,100 lb, with manual single-speed or two-speed foot pumps or 12V DC powered lift.
categories: Lift Tables > Stainless Steel Lift Tables
Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Vestil Foot Pump and Powered Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Stationary scissor lift tables in foot pump, 12V DC and 460V AC versions, rated 400 to 2,500 lb.
lines.content:
SCTAB tables have torsion tubes for side-to-side stability and a pressure flow control valve for controlled lowering. Foot pump models need no power.

DC models run on a 12V battery with an onboard charger and a two-button hand control, and AC models on 460V three-phase power. Capacities run from 400 to 2,500 lb.
key_features: Foot pump, 12V DC and 460V AC versions
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Vestil Pneumatic Tire Elevating Carts
lines.excerpt: Rough-terrain hydraulic lift carts on pneumatic tires, rated 400 to 1,500 lb.
lines.content:
Pneumatic Tire Elevating Carts roll on large air tires over gravel, grass and uneven ground, for nurseries, landscaping, construction and agricultural sites. A hydraulic foot pump raises the load and a controlled lowering valve lets it down smoothly.

Models are rated from 400 to 1,500 lb in several platform sizes, with welded, powder-coated steel frames.

lines.title: Vestil DC Powered and Manual Scissor Carts
lines.excerpt: Mobile scissor carts in 12V DC and auto-shift foot pump versions, rated 1,000 and 1,500 lb.
lines.content:
These carts lift, move and position materials in either 12V DC powered or manual form. DC units have an internal motor, 12V battery, 115V charger and detachable hand control on a coil cord. Manual units use a two-speed auto-shift foot pump.

Models are rated at 1,000 or 1,500 lb, with platforms from 24 x 36 in. to 40 x 48 in.
key_features: Platforms from 24 x 36 in. to 40 x 48 in.
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Vestil DC Powered Hydraulic Elevating Carts
lines.excerpt: Battery-powered push-button scissor lift carts rated 500 to 2,500 lb, in single and double scissor designs.
lines.content:
DC Powered Hydraulic Elevating Carts replace foot pumping with push-button lifting from a 12V battery with an onboard charger.

Capacities run from 500 to 2,500 lb, with single and double scissor designs for standard and extended lift heights, in steel.
categories: Lift Tables > Double Scissor Lift Tables
Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Vestil Powered Drive Elevating Carts
lines.excerpt: Scissor lift carts with motorized travel and powered lift, rated 500 to 2,000 lb.
lines.content:
These carts add a powered drive to a powered scissor lift, cutting the pushing and pulling involved in moving heavy loads. The 24V DC powered drive carts travel forward and reverse at 0 to 3.7 mph, with a throttle, horn, key switch, emergency reverse, automatic braking and battery charge indicator, in single and double scissor versions.

Traction drive carts use a twist throttle with reverse, powered front drive wheels, two 12V batteries and an onboard charger. Capacities across both run from 500 to 2,000 lb.
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Vestil Air Hydraulic Carts
lines.excerpt: Air-over-hydraulic scissor lift carts with a backup foot pump, rated 800 to 2,000 lb.
lines.content:
Air Hydraulic Carts lift quickly with a reciprocating air-over-hydraulic system when connected to compressed air, and an integrated two-speed foot pump allows precise adjustment or lifting when air is not available.

Models are rated from 800 to 2,000 lb in several platform sizes and lift ranges, on poly-on-poly wheels.

lines.title: Vestil Lift and Tilt Carts
lines.excerpt: Foot pump carts that raise and tilt containers, rated 400 to 1,000 lb.
lines.content:
Lift & Tilt Carts raise and tilt materials to an ergonomic position. CART-1000-LT models use a manual selector valve so lift and tilt can be run independently from one foot pump, with a 7 in. retaining lip.

CART-400-LT and CART-600-LT models tilt to 45 degrees automatically as they rise. Capacities run from 400 to 1,000 lb, and partially stainless steel versions are available.

lines.title: Vestil Linear Actuated Elevating Carts
lines.excerpt: Battery-powered linear actuator scissor carts that do not drift, rated 400 to 500 lb.
lines.content:
Linear Actuated Elevating Carts raise and lower with an electric linear actuator for precise positioning, and the actuator won't let the platform drift down the way hydraulic carts can.

Models are rated at 400 or 500 lb. Steel models run on two 12V AGM batteries with a bench charger and an emergency stop, and the partially stainless steel model uses a lithium battery with an onboard charger.
key_features: Linear actuator lift with no drift
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables
